FlavorIt ruins them in seconds and lingers while they scream.
FlavorAs always, you've left me nothing to mourn.
FlavorYou wallow in entropy and call it renewal.
FlavorPlease say something, say anything.
FlavorHave I troubled you? Replace me, then.
FlavorWhen the birds sing, the rot sets in.
FlavorWhy destroy something just to replace it?
FlavorIn that moment, she didn't look at me with fearful eyes.
FlavorGlaust...
FlavorI saw it, in a dream. The great peace... It disgusted me.
FlavorSmall game wasn't enough. He craved more. He craved the fight.
FlavorAnd then he slept among the Kralkatorrik's Emergence Zonerolling hills. A mountain, he lingered Blood Legion Homelandsthere.
FlavorMother.
FlavorGlintHer Aurenechild reached out to me, to my mind. She was curious.
FlavorWhen her cheeks hit the ground, she'll come to understand the cost of betrayal.
FlavorCracks of lightning and dark clouds encompassed him like plated armor.
FlavorI never feared the possibility... I never feared anything.
FlavorA flicker of light at the corner of my eye. For a moment, I thought it was her.
FlavorAnd in his wake there was nothing but crystal and blood.
FlavorI outgrew Elder Dragonthem so quickly, Soo-Wonshe barely had time to mourn my departure...
FlavorIn that final moment, he looked for her.
FlavorAs the shard The Crystal Dragonimpaled Aureneher, a scream flickered in his mind.
FlavorThe crazed god's lust for power was admirable, albeit misguided.
FlavorYou must have known your history, to relive it over and over...
Double-click to summon this mini to follow you around. Only one mini may be in use at a time.
FlavorWhy can't you come? Are you...trapped?
FlavorIf all things have limits, where are mine...?
FlavorI thought I could go ahead. And you could—
Flavor...but you must act now. No one else can see it; only you.
FlavorIt is poison, yes... But they mean to kill you.
FlavorThe further I reach, the more I understand.
FlavorSoft growth needs armor. It should have been painless.
FlavorThis is your true calling. You feel it. You know it.
FlavorIn every domain, I adapt. I thrive.
FlavorThe truth was...inevitable. And now they know.
FlavorYou were wrong... It's endless. I am endless.
FlavorIt comforts you to believe that. I can wait.
FlavorIt's time. Open the door. Now, walk outside.
FlavorNo. Only your stubborn solitude diminishes you.
FlavorNothing grows where their corpses fell. No, not yet...
FlavorYour eyes lie—life is in eternal motion.
Flavor"Dread" is cold.
FlavorDon't panic, but I heard her—
FlavorHe made the most terrible sound.
FlavorGo on. I like to listen.
FlavorYou wish you'd never known anything.
FlavorI don't want to feel it.
FlavorIt reached the water, cooled, and stopped.
Flavor"Instinct" means you have to do it.
FlavorSomething happened to him down there.
FlavorNoise is color: white, brown, red.
FlavorTake it away from me.
FlavorI can touch it. It doesn't hurt.
FlavorIf this is what you are, be all of it.
FlavorYou can't make yourself ask them.
Flavor"Legacy"? It follows you.
FlavorYou can't hear yourself think.
FlavorShe looked at him with waning eyes. He would be the last to leave her.
FlavorHer realm was cool and dark; not an empty darkness, but a soft one.
Flavor"Good night," she whispered. They were little more than speckles of light.
FlavorDon't step out of the light, little one.
FlavorThey would know that she knew, and that scared her more than anything.
FlavorInnocent flickers of pure magic, they were. Innocent, but destined.
FlavorIn those final moments, she could see them. Some smiled.
FlavorAnd then there was nothing but dust and shadow.
FlavorJormagThey looked at Soo-Wonher with those icy blue eyes. She disappointed them.
FlavorI did as any mother would; I wept for Elder Dragonthem.
FlavorAround her neck its tendrils wrapped. She could feel no more.
FlavorBefore there was a "them," there was nothing but swirling stars.
FlavorThey tethered me to the world. Without them, I'd have floated away.
FlavorWhen the egg hatched, she felt the world sigh.
FlavorEvery wound, every tear; she felt them live. And die.
FlavorVoidIt slithered through Soo-Wonher like a wurm in the jungle. It preyed on her.
FlavorA perfect state in which the worst that could happen is already over...
FlavorI have a purpose for everything you remember.
FlavorWe can use anything that remains of you. Don't justify yourself with a purpose.
FlavorLiving minds are obsessed with decisions they have no power to make...
FlavorThink of the terror they all endured, and the wounds they tried to survive...
FlavorA living being's most primal fear—its antithesis—is death.
FlavorThe simplicity of living in ruins is that they are what you make of them.
FlavorLike all ruins, they become what they are, not what they held.
FlavorThe gates have fallen, the walls have crumbled...
FlavorI didn't notice at first... Perhaps I wasn't looking.
FlavorCertainty is better than faith.
FlavorI no longer recognize myself without it...
FlavorI can build a world out of the things you're too small to understand.
FlavorI am the curator of eternity's refuse.
FlavorTheir vastness has endless potential...

apiData.requirement: Open the final chest of the Celestial Challenge in Divinity's Reach. This achievement can be completed once a year.

apiData.requirement: Find and light all of the firecrackers in the Crown Pavilion.

metadata.description: CollectibleJuvenile Elonian raptors rely more on cuteness than leaping ability.Combine 3 Green Raptors with 2 Unidentified Dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Mini Blue Raptor HatchlingBlue Raptor.

CollectibleMini jackal pups are handcrafted with specially selected runes to be the perfect eternal puppy.Combine 3 yellow jackal pups with 2 Unidentified Dyeunidentified dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Mini Red Jackal Pup.
Griffon hatchlings are extremely energetic and precocious.Combine 3 Mini Red Griffon Hatchlings with 2 Unidentified DyeUnidentifed Dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Mini Blue Griffon Hatchling.
Contrary to certain folklore, springer kits are not hatched from eggs.Combine 3 Brown Springer Kits with 2 Unidentified Dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Red Springer Kit.
Surprisingly, newborn skimmer pups don't need any parental care after birth.Combine 3 Mini Blue Skimmer Pups with 2 Unidentified Dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Mini Green Skimmer Pup.
A fluffy friend from across the Mists.Combine 3 Mini Red Shiba InuRed Shiba Inu with 2 Unidentified Dyes in the Mystic Forge to create a Mini Black and Tan Shiba InuBlack and Tan Shiba Inu.
